record_count_derivation: 3 rounds * (160 single-query batches + 5 batches of 32) * (2 devices * 7 models * 2 stages + 1 common CPU preparation stage)
plotted_value_derivation: 2 devices * 7 models * (2 batch-one latency quantiles + 2 batch32 interface throughputs)
fixes: Bind exact audit/dependency hashes before and after raw reading, then before and after snapshot copying.
Retain every independently audited dependency as a collision-free workspace-relative snapshot.
Derive CUDA device title from measured environment rather than a hard-coded graphics-card name.
Add independent actual-figure arithmetic/export entry that waits without real inputs.
confirmed_semantics: One query returns 61 times, not one scalar time step.
Batch-one milliseconds use actual median/p95 of 480 observations; p95 is not a confidence interval.
Batch32 throughput is sum(cases)/sum(elapsed_s), not inverse median or single-query latency.
Feature preparation is common to all models and separately preserved; no unused-attribute speed optimization is implied.
No missing slow timings are discarded; repeated rounds reuse the same 160 geometries and seed42 checkpoints.
Historical training-cost summaries are companions, not isolated architecture timing or mixed-hardware FE speedup.
